title: Ravelry Project Update Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Ravelry projects (`ravelry:project`), knitCompanion row counters (`knitcompanion:counter`), Shelly smart-plug machine runtime (`shelly:status`), and Ravelry stash entries (`ravelry:stash`).
app: Ravelry project and stash exports, knitCompanion row-counter logs, and Shelly plug telemetry for sewing-machine hours sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=ravelry:project
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(project_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Ravelry project update events land each day and how many distinct project name values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Ravelry project update records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct project name values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It warns how much Ravelry project update activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
